name: Majetok. Chastyna 3. Harderob.
source:
When the door first opened, the mind began to find reality. Piece by piece, putting together a whimsical puzzle of disparate ideas. Darkness opposes truth, lies oppose light. The truth does not want to be found. Or does not have to be.

[Translated from [url=https://merkuri-chan.itch.io/harderob]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当门第一次打开时，心灵开始寻找现实。一点一点地，将不同的想法拼凑成一个异想天开的谜题。黑暗对抗真理，谎言对抗光明。真相并不想被发现。或者不一定是。

[译自[url=https://merkuri-chan.itch.io/harderob]itch.io[/url]]
